info.headline: Notify NYC - CERT Search & Rescue Exercise - 10/4- Coney Island (BK)
info.description:
Notification issued 10-03-2026 at 03:05 PM.
As part of a Community Emergency Response Team (CERT) training class, a search and rescue exercise will be conducted at approximately 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM on 10/4 in the area of Coney Island, Brooklyn. Expect to see FDNY and NYPD personnel in action. To learn more about CERT, visit http://www.NYC.gov/CERT.
